about: Custom types P4: monsters.json keys a community mod writes are accepted. A top-level _note, mood_shift_x/y (a spawned unit of the type carries them, a type without them the like's 6/-56), shift_x/shift_y on a sprite (moves it: origin minus the shift, on top of the bottom-centre default for walk and idle), raid_cat_spacing (ignored, one log line). icon, heads and infant_head without xorig / yorig take the origin of the game sheet they stand in for (10 10, 10 10, 5 14); one with xorig / yorig keeps its own, and a shift moves either. A key no type knows (outside "_" comments) is still a mod error.
